The '''1937-38 Serie A''' was the thirty-eighth edition of the [[Italian Football Championship]] and its ninth since [[1929–30 Serie A|1929]] re-[[brand]]ing to create [[Serie A]]. It was the fifteenth season from which the Italian Football Champions adorned their team jerseys in the subsequent season with a [[Scudetto]]. [[Inter Milan|Ambrosiana-Inter]] were champions for the fourth time in their [[history]]. This was their second scudetto since the scudetto started being awarded in [[1923–24 Prima Divisione|1924]] and their second win contested as Serie A. This was the first of two Inter punctuations of a run of four [[Bologna FC 1909|Bologna]] wins from six consecutive Serie A competitions until 1941.
[[Image:Serie A (football) 1937-38.png|thumb|325px|right|Serie A 1937-38 teams distribution]]

==Teams==
[[AS Livorno|Livorno]] and [[Atalanta BC|Atalanta]] had been promoted from [[Serie B]].
